source: OpenAI image_gen, generated for DoggyKnight during the equipment implementation
design_brief: 18 original storybook fantasy equipment icons in a 6 by 3 atlas. Warm hand-painted metal, wood, fabric and jewel materials; readable silhouettes; no text or external game characters. First row: sword, staff, bow, padded vest, ranger jacket, apprentice robe. Second: sunblade, moonstaff, stormbow, oathplate, mistcloak, starrobe. Third: bell, hearth heart, leaf compass, hourglass, thorn badge, Avalon grail.
design_brief_note: Summary of the requested design, not an exact prompt transcript.
